crossRefs.note: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from…
crossRefs.keyword: a trumpet. Heb. trumpets in the hand of all of them. empty

translations.web: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
translations.bsb: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
translations.kjv: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
translations.asv: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets, and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
